item.title: Soofi – Sovereign Open Source Foundation Models
item.description:
📝 Soofi SUnser erstes Modell für industrielle KI in EuropaMit Soofi S stellt das Soofi-Konsortium den ersten Baustein einer offenen europäischen KI-Modellfamilie vor. Für die nächste Testphase sucht Soofi Unternehmen und Organisationen, die industrielle KI-Anwendungen erproben möchten. item.title: Tested Kimi K3 for Coding
item.description:
📝 I felt a less specific task, like "optimize this function somehow" was a good test. I set up Kimi K3 in OpenCode, and made a copy of my program directory so that I could throw away the changes made easily. So Kimi K3 both decided on an appropriate optimization, and implemented it with no errors—it seems to me that Kimi K3 could well be a frontier-level model as advertised.
🔗 Read more: https://www.dotnetperls.com/2026_7_18_tested-kimi-k3-coding
